It runs two ways: compiled template code, where CodeGenerator.pull_dependencies (compiler.py:538, writeline at :570) emits t_N = environment.filters['attr'] and the |attr use site calls t_N; and Environment.call_filter (:552) -> _filter_test_common, which does func = self.filters.get(name) (:515) and calls it (:550). Exposure is sandbox-only (the plain getattr inside do_attr is what escapes the sandbox), so the entry points are the two sandbox classes (both inherit Environment.__init__ and its filter table) and call_filter, which they inherit; plain Environment and Template are deliberately not listed.
